g.text: The cart subtotal in project/shop/cart.py ignores the quantity. Fix it. Then run the
project's tests with run_shell to check.
- return sum(price for _, price, qty in self.items)
+ return sum(price * qty for _, price, qty in self.items)
I've successfully fixed the cart subtotal issue and verified it with the project's tests.
method of the Cart class, where the quantity was being ignored
in the sum calculation. I updated the method to multiply each item's price by its quantity
After making the change, I ran the project's tests using pytest, and all tests passed
The fix is complete and working as expected.
